description: This file defines a URL class that constructs and provides access to weather API URLs based on location coordinates and city names for a weather app.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: A class for constructing weather API endpoint URLs based on location and city name.

methods.name: URL()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the weather data URL based on current location coordinates.

methods.name: getLink()
methods.description: Returns the constructed URL for the weather data API call.

methods.name: setCity_url(String cityName)
methods.description: Static method to set the URL for fetching weather data for a specified city.

methods.name: getCity_url()
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the URL for the current city weather API call.
